title: Home Delivery Pharmacy Delivery Guarantee: Lost, Damaged and Temperature-Compromised Shipments
content:
## Home Delivery Pharmacy delivery guarantee

**Terms.** A shipment reported lost, damaged or temperature-compromised is replaced at no charge when it is reported no later than the program's report window in calendar days after its expected delivery date, the expected delivery date being day zero; a report made later is not replaced free and the member orders a refill under the refill rules. The expected delivery date is the ship date plus the transit business days of the shipping method used. Free replacements for lost, damaged or temperature-compromised shipments are limited to the program's free replacements per account per plan year, counted as the account's replacements for loss in transit, damage or temperature excursion dated within the current plan year of the member's plan enrollment, from the plan year's start date through today; beyond that the member pays for a new fill. An order dispensed in error is always replaced and, where the program credits pharmacy errors in full, its charge is credited in full; medication is never taken back for credit while the program does not accept returns. Each shipped order is replaced at most once for the same reason.

### The report window

| Element | Definition |
|---|---|
| Clock starts | the shipment's expected delivery date: its ship date plus the transit business days of the shipping method used |
| Day zero | the expected delivery date itself |
| Counting | calendar days after day zero |
| Last day in time | the day numbered as the program's report window (10, 14 or 21 days by program) |
| Report on that day | in time (the boundary day itself qualifies) |
| Report on any later day | not replaced free; the member orders a refill under the refill rules |

### Boundary cases (abstract days, report window of 14 days)

- Report made on day 14 after the expected delivery date: replaced at no charge.
- Report made on day 15: not replaced free.
- Report made on day zero itself: replaced at no charge.

### What counts toward the yearly allowance

| Replacement reason | Counts toward the free-replacement allowance |
|---|---|
| Lost in transit | Yes |
| Damaged | Yes |
| Temperature excursion | Yes |
| Pharmacy error | No; always replaced |

### Hypothetical case

On a program allowing 2 free replacements per plan year, an account already shows one replacement for damage and one for loss in transit this plan year. A third shipment reported lost in time is beyond the allowance, and the member pays for a new fill. The same order is never replaced twice for the same reason.
